title: Divine Wills and the Walls of Ideas
english: If they are of God, they are wills of God. And take by way of example that which is being observed: he who intends to construct a city outlines the whole city and its parts with his own intellect, and according to those thoughts, he constructs the perceptible things. For certainly, if he does not take the meaning correctly—for instance, of the marketplace or the precinct or the others—he does not construct the perceptible things well.

Therefore, the ideas are able to be the walls, written in the hands of God, which are wills. Thus, these walls have their being in the will of God. And I say: 'In Christ,' he says, 'all things were created, those in the heavens and those upon the earth, the visible and the invisible, whether principalities or powers; all things exist through him; and he is before all things, and all things in him consist' (Colossians 1:16-17). In him the visible and the invisible were created; just as if the parts of a city were built in the mind of the architect, that is, in relation to those [ideas], being held together by them; for they are words of a sustaining kind. In Christ, therefore, all things consist.

If by reflection you wish to take away the word from the existing things, these things do not stand. They come together by the lifting up of the word. So also the walls; all security is written in the hands of God. And if you also call the virtues walls, the virtues too have ideas, which you will have as archetypes. For example, I have justice, but not all of it, but I have fashioned it according to itself. And the thing being thought of is not without the partaker, just like an idea; not 'idea' in the way you are accustomed to saying. If, therefore, you take away knowledge, the qualities of the knowers are taken away; they come together with it, and being placed there, they partake of it, and they are qualities according to a part. But there is another [idea] besides these, which is more original and more certain. For certainly, this one does not accept the more and the less, whereas that which is in the partakers accepts this. Therefore, the walls signify security. Lord God of truth, redeem me.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
